userStories.title: Slice 6: Subtask Execution — RunPersonaSubtaskJob + Failure Handling + Completion Logging
acceptanceCriteria: `PersonaCycleService::startSubtaskExecution()` creates a Task, clones repo workspace, dispatches first `RunPersonaSubtaskJob`
`RunPersonaSubtaskJob` reads current subtask from proposal, builds prompt with subtask instructions + persona context + previous results
`RunPersonaSubtaskJob` executes Claude via proc_open with all MCPs, streams output to Task messages
On success: subtask status updated to "completed", `current_subtask_index` advanced, next job dispatched
On all subtasks complete: `completeExecution()` called — logs to completed-plans, updates context.md, marks proposal complete
On failure: subtask status set to "failed", Task marked WaitingForInput, Telegram failure notification sent
On failure: no auto-retry, no auto-skip — execution stops and waits for human input
"Resume Subtask" Filament action retries the failed subtask
"Skip Subtask" Filament action marks subtask as skipped and advances to next
Completed plan logged to `storage/personas/{slug}/completed-plans/{date}-{slug}.md` with full summary
Persona `context.md` updated with key learnings after completion
Telegram completion notification sent when all subtasks done
Feature test: sequential subtask execution completes all subtasks in order

Feature test: resume action retries failed subtask
Feature test: completion logging writes correct files
